cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(webcpp_portable_network_consumer LANGUAGES CXX)

# This consumer reads only an unpacked source tree, explicit Boost headers and
# the chosen compiler/SDK. It does not invoke B2 or modify any installed library.
set(WEBCPP_SOURCE_ROOT "" CACHE PATH "Unpacked WebCPP source root")
set(BOOST_INCLUDE_DIR "" CACHE PATH "Boost 1.92 headers")
set(WEBCPP_TARGET "native" CACHE STRING "native, wasip2, wasip3 or emscripten")
set(WEBCPP_SUSPEND "jspi" CACHE STRING "Emscripten suspension: jspi or asyncify")
set(WEBCPP_WASI_SDK "" CACHE PATH "Explicit WASI SDK directory")
set(WEBCPP_OPENSSL_PREFIX "" CACHE PATH "Explicit matching static OpenSSL provider")
set(WEBCPP_CA_INCLUDE "" CACHE PATH "Explicit embedded CA header include root")
set(WEBCPP_COBALT_EXECUTOR "any" CACHE STRING "Cobalt executor: any, io_context or custom")
set(WEBCPP_COBALT_PMR "std" CACHE STRING "Cobalt memory policy: std, none or custom")
option(WEBCPP_EXCEPTIONS "Enable C++ exceptions" ON)
option(WEBCPP_THREADS "Enable compiler pthread/cooperative ABI" OFF)
if(NOT WEBCPP_SOURCE_ROOT OR NOT BOOST_INCLUDE_DIR)
  message(FATAL_ERROR "Set WEBCPP_SOURCE_ROOT and BOOST_INCLUDE_DIR explicitly")
endif()
file(STRINGS "${BOOST_INCLUDE_DIR}/boost/version.hpp" boost_version REGEX "^#define BOOST_VERSION ")
if(NOT boost_version STREQUAL "#define BOOST_VERSION 109200")
  message(FATAL_ERROR "The shipped Cobalt sources require matching Boost 1.92 headers")
endif()

add_library(consumer_configuration INTERFACE)
target_compile_features(consumer_configuration INTERFACE cxx_std_20)
target_compile_options(consumer_configuration INTERFACE -O2)
target_include_directories(consumer_configuration SYSTEM INTERFACE "${BOOST_INCLUDE_DIR}")
foreach(library config asio cobalt beast)
  target_include_directories(consumer_configuration INTERFACE "${WEBCPP_SOURCE_ROOT}/libs/${library}/include")
endforeach()
target_compile_definitions(consumer_configuration INTERFACE BOOST_COBALT_NO_LIB=1)
if(WEBCPP_COBALT_EXECUTOR STREQUAL "io_context")
  target_compile_definitions(consumer_configuration INTERFACE BOOST_COBALT_USE_IO_CONTEXT=1)
elseif(WEBCPP_COBALT_EXECUTOR STREQUAL "custom")
  target_compile_definitions(consumer_configuration INTERFACE BOOST_COBALT_CUSTOM_EXECUTOR=1)
elseif(NOT WEBCPP_COBALT_EXECUTOR STREQUAL "any")
  message(FATAL_ERROR "Unknown WEBCPP_COBALT_EXECUTOR")
endif()
if(WEBCPP_COBALT_PMR STREQUAL "none")
  target_compile_definitions(consumer_configuration INTERFACE BOOST_COBALT_NO_PMR=1)
elseif(WEBCPP_COBALT_PMR STREQUAL "custom")
  target_compile_definitions(consumer_configuration INTERFACE BOOST_COBALT_USE_CUSTOM_PMR=1)
elseif(NOT WEBCPP_COBALT_PMR STREQUAL "std")
  message(FATAL_ERROR "Unknown WEBCPP_COBALT_PMR")
endif()
if(WEBCPP_COBALT_EXECUTOR STREQUAL "custom" OR WEBCPP_COBALT_PMR STREQUAL "custom")
  target_compile_options(consumer_configuration INTERFACE
    -include "${WEBCPP_SOURCE_ROOT}/consumers/consumer_config.hpp")
endif()
set(runtime_sources)
file(READ "${WEBCPP_SOURCE_ROOT}/libs/asio/sources.json" asio_contract)
foreach(kind runtime private_include)
  string(JSON count LENGTH "${asio_contract}" profiles "${WEBCPP_TARGET}" "${kind}")
  if(count GREATER 0)
    math(EXPR last "${count} - 1")
    foreach(index RANGE 0 ${last})
      string(JSON relative GET "${asio_contract}" profiles "${WEBCPP_TARGET}" "${kind}" ${index})
      set(path "${WEBCPP_SOURCE_ROOT}/libs/asio/${relative}")
      if(kind STREQUAL "runtime")
        list(APPEND runtime_sources "${path}")
      else()
        target_include_directories(consumer_configuration INTERFACE "${path}")
      endif()
    endforeach()
  endif()
endforeach()
if(WEBCPP_TARGET MATCHES "^wasi")
  if(NOT WEBCPP_WASI_SDK)
    message(FATAL_ERROR "WASI requires WEBCPP_WASI_SDK")
  endif()
  target_compile_options(consumer_configuration INTERFACE "--target=wasm32-${WEBCPP_TARGET}")
  target_link_options(consumer_configuration INTERFACE "--target=wasm32-${WEBCPP_TARGET}")
  set(runtime_dir "${WEBCPP_SOURCE_ROOT}/libs/asio/src/${WEBCPP_TARGET}")
  find_package(Python3 REQUIRED COMPONENTS Interpreter)
  execute_process(COMMAND "${Python3_EXECUTABLE}" "${runtime_dir}/verify.py" --sdk "${WEBCPP_WASI_SDK}"
                  COMMAND_ERROR_IS_FATAL ANY)
  if(WEBCPP_THREADS)
    if(NOT WEBCPP_TARGET STREQUAL "wasip3" OR WEBCPP_EXCEPTIONS)
      message(FATAL_ERROR "SDK 34 supplies cooperative threads for WASIp3 without exceptions only")
    endif()
    set(cooperative_sysroot "${WEBCPP_WASI_SDK}/share/wasi-sysroot/experimental-coop-threads")
    target_compile_options(consumer_configuration INTERFACE "--sysroot=${cooperative_sysroot}" -pthread)
    target_link_options(consumer_configuration INTERFACE "--sysroot=${cooperative_sysroot}" -pthread)
    target_include_directories(consumer_configuration SYSTEM INTERFACE "${WEBCPP_WASI_SDK}/share/wasi-sysroot/include/c++/v1")
  endif()
  if(WEBCPP_EXCEPTIONS)
    target_compile_options(consumer_configuration INTERFACE -fwasm-exceptions -mllvm -wasm-use-legacy-eh=false)
    target_link_options(consumer_configuration INTERFACE -fwasm-exceptions)
    target_link_libraries(consumer_configuration INTERFACE unwind)
  endif()
elseif(WEBCPP_TARGET STREQUAL "emscripten")
  if(WEBCPP_THREADS)
    message(FATAL_ERROR "This consumer runs in Node; use the browser worker harness for pthread profiles")
  endif()
  target_link_options(consumer_configuration INTERFACE -lembind -sEXIT_RUNTIME=1 -sENVIRONMENT=node
    -Wl,--export=emscripten_stack_get_current -Wl,--export=_emscripten_stack_restore)
  if(WEBCPP_SUSPEND STREQUAL "jspi")
    target_link_options(consumer_configuration INTERFACE -sJSPI)
    if(WEBCPP_EXCEPTIONS)
      target_compile_options(consumer_configuration INTERFACE -fwasm-exceptions)
      target_link_options(consumer_configuration INTERFACE -fwasm-exceptions)
    endif()
  elseif(WEBCPP_SUSPEND STREQUAL "asyncify")
    target_link_options(consumer_configuration INTERFACE -sASYNCIFY -sASYNCIFY_STACK_SIZE=8192)
    if(WEBCPP_EXCEPTIONS)
      target_compile_options(consumer_configuration INTERFACE -fexceptions)
      target_link_options(consumer_configuration INTERFACE -fexceptions)
    endif()
  else()
    message(FATAL_ERROR "Unknown WEBCPP_SUSPEND")
  endif()
elseif(NOT WEBCPP_TARGET STREQUAL "native")
  message(FATAL_ERROR "Unknown WEBCPP_TARGET")
elseif(WEBCPP_THREADS)
  target_compile_options(consumer_configuration INTERFACE -pthread)
  target_link_options(consumer_configuration INTERFACE -pthread)
endif()
if(NOT WEBCPP_EXCEPTIONS)
  target_compile_options(consumer_configuration INTERFACE -fno-exceptions)
  target_link_options(consumer_configuration INTERFACE -fno-exceptions)
  list(APPEND runtime_sources "${WEBCPP_SOURCE_ROOT}/consumers/throw_exception.cpp")
endif()

add_library(asio_runtime INTERFACE)
if(runtime_sources)
  # Emscripten's EM_JS metadata is not an ordinary unresolved C++ symbol.
  # Keep the bridge object in the final link, as a direct compiler invocation does.
  add_library(asio_runtime_objects OBJECT ${runtime_sources})
  target_link_libraries(asio_runtime_objects PUBLIC consumer_configuration)
  target_link_libraries(asio_runtime INTERFACE asio_runtime_objects $<TARGET_OBJECTS:asio_runtime_objects>)
endif()
target_link_libraries(asio_runtime INTERFACE consumer_configuration)
add_executable(customizations "${WEBCPP_SOURCE_ROOT}/consumers/customizations.cpp"
  "${WEBCPP_SOURCE_ROOT}/consumers/peer.cpp")
target_link_libraries(customizations PRIVATE asio_runtime)
if(WEBCPP_TARGET MATCHES "^wasi")
  set_target_properties(customizations PROPERTIES SUFFIX ".wasm")
elseif(WEBCPP_TARGET STREQUAL "emscripten")
  set_target_properties(customizations PROPERTIES SUFFIX ".js")
endif()

file(READ "${WEBCPP_SOURCE_ROOT}/libs/cobalt/sources.json" cobalt_contract)
function(cobalt_sources output kind)
  string(JSON count LENGTH "${cobalt_contract}" profiles "${WEBCPP_TARGET}" "${kind}")
  set(selected)
  if(count GREATER 0)
    math(EXPR last "${count} - 1")
    foreach(index RANGE 0 ${last})
      string(JSON source GET "${cobalt_contract}" profiles "${WEBCPP_TARGET}" "${kind}" ${index})
      list(APPEND selected "${WEBCPP_SOURCE_ROOT}/libs/cobalt/${source}")
    endforeach()
  endif()
  set(${output} "${selected}" PARENT_SCOPE)
endfunction()
cobalt_sources(core_sources core)
if(WEBCPP_THREADS)
  cobalt_sources(thread_sources multi_add)
  list(APPEND core_sources ${thread_sources})
endif()
cobalt_sources(runner_sources runner)
add_library(cobalt_core STATIC ${core_sources})
target_link_libraries(cobalt_core PUBLIC asio_runtime)
if(WEBCPP_TARGET STREQUAL "native")
  target_compile_definitions(cobalt_core PRIVATE BOOST_COBALT_SOURCE=1 BOOST_COBALT_IO_SOURCE=1)
else()
  target_compile_definitions(cobalt_core PRIVATE WEBCPP_COBALT_BACKEND_SOURCE=1 WEBCPP_COBALT_BACKEND_IO_SOURCE=1)
endif()
add_library(cobalt_runner STATIC ${runner_sources})
target_link_libraries(cobalt_runner PUBLIC cobalt_core)
add_executable(timers "${WEBCPP_SOURCE_ROOT}/consumers/timers.cpp"
  "${WEBCPP_SOURCE_ROOT}/consumers/configuration.cpp")
target_link_libraries(timers PRIVATE cobalt_runner)
if(WEBCPP_THREADS)
  add_executable(threads "${WEBCPP_SOURCE_ROOT}/consumers/threads.cpp")
  target_link_libraries(threads PRIVATE cobalt_core)
  if(WEBCPP_TARGET MATCHES "^wasi")
    set_target_properties(threads PROPERTIES SUFFIX ".wasm")
  endif()
endif()
if(WEBCPP_OPENSSL_PREFIX)
  if(WEBCPP_TARGET STREQUAL "emscripten" OR NOT WEBCPP_CA_INCLUDE)
    message(FATAL_ERROR "Guest TLS requires native/WASI and an explicit CA include root")
  endif()
  cobalt_sources(ssl_sources ssl)
  add_library(cobalt_ssl STATIC ${ssl_sources})
  target_link_libraries(cobalt_ssl PUBLIC cobalt_core
    "${WEBCPP_OPENSSL_PREFIX}/libssl.a" "${WEBCPP_OPENSSL_PREFIX}/libcrypto.a")
  target_include_directories(cobalt_ssl PUBLIC "${WEBCPP_OPENSSL_PREFIX}/include" "${WEBCPP_CA_INCLUDE}")
  target_compile_definitions(cobalt_ssl PUBLIC WEBCPP_ASIO_HAS_OPENSSL=1 WEBCPP_COBALT_LINK_SSL=1)
  if(WEBCPP_TARGET MATCHES "^wasi")
    # These are the explicit libc support libraries of WebCPP's OpenSSL provider.
    target_link_libraries(cobalt_ssl PUBLIC wasi-emulated-getpid wasi-emulated-signal
      wasi-emulated-process-clocks wasi-emulated-mman)
  endif()
  foreach(program ssl_client ssl_state ssl_cancel)
    add_executable(${program} "${WEBCPP_SOURCE_ROOT}/consumers/${program}.cpp"
      "${WEBCPP_SOURCE_ROOT}/consumers/configuration.cpp")
    target_include_directories(${program} PRIVATE "${WEBCPP_SOURCE_ROOT}/consumers/include")
    target_link_libraries(${program} PRIVATE cobalt_runner cobalt_ssl)
    if(WEBCPP_TARGET MATCHES "^wasi")
      set_target_properties(${program} PROPERTIES SUFFIX ".wasm")
    endif()
  endforeach()
endif()
if(WEBCPP_TARGET STREQUAL "emscripten")
  add_executable(browser "${WEBCPP_SOURCE_ROOT}/consumers/browser.cpp")
  target_link_libraries(browser PRIVATE asio_runtime)
  set_target_properties(timers browser PROPERTIES SUFFIX ".js")
else()
  foreach(program network beast)
    add_executable(${program} "${WEBCPP_SOURCE_ROOT}/consumers/${program}.cpp")
    target_link_libraries(${program} PRIVATE asio_runtime)
  endforeach()
  if(WEBCPP_TARGET MATCHES "^wasi")
    set_target_properties(timers network beast PROPERTIES SUFFIX ".wasm")
  endif()
endif()
